agent_assessment: Implementation fully matches plan. All 5 phases are complete: (1) internal/identity/ package with secret.go, token.go, claims.go implementing HMAC-SHA256 signing with 32-byte secret, base64url wire format, and 0600 file permissions; (2) Token generation in RunExecutor.generateIdentityToken() populating all specified claims fields, injected via VROOLI_AGENT_IDENTITY_TOKEN through MergedEnvVars() for all run types; (3) identity_token_hash and identity_token_revoked_at columns in runs table, revocation called in all three terminal handlers; (4) POST /api/v1/identity/verify endpoint returns 200+claims+run_status for valid non-expired tokens, 401 for invalid/expired — matching the contract exactly; (5) 12 tests covering all specified test plan items pass. Build, full test suite (all 22 packages), gofumpt formatting, and golangci-lint all pass clean. No regressions detected.
notes: generateIdentityToken() is non-fatal by design — if identity secret is not configured, run proceeds without token. This matches the plan's backward compatibility requirement.
IdentityVerifyResult uses domain.RunStatus type for run_status field, ensuring consistency with run lifecycle states.
Token secret is initialized in main.go via identity.LoadOrCreateSecret(database.DataDir()), failing startup if secret cannot be loaded — matches plan's security-first posture.

evidence.title: Code review — Claims struct matches contract
evidence.description: Claims struct in claims.go has all 7 fields from the plan contract: run_id (uuid.UUID), task_id (uuid.UUID), profile_key (string), scope_path (string), iat (int64), exp (int64), meta (map[string]string). JSON tags match the specified wire format exactly.

evidence.title: Code review — Wire format matches contract
evidence.description: GenerateToken() in token.go produces base64url(json_claims) + '.' + base64url(hmac_sha256(payload, secret)), exactly matching the specified wire format. Uses crypto/hmac + crypto/sha256 from stdlib only (no JWT library).

evidence.title: Code review — Verification endpoint matches contract
evidence.description: POST /api/v1/identity/verify accepts {"token": "..."}, returns {"valid": true, "claims": {...}, "run_status": "..."/} on success (200) or {"valid": false, "error": "..."} on failure (401). IdentityVerifyResult struct fields match: Valid (bool), Claims (*identity.Claims, omitempty), RunStatus (domain.RunStatus, omitempty), Error (string, omitempty).

evidence.title: Code review — Token lifecycle in terminal handlers
evidence.description: revokeIdentityToken() is called in all three terminal handlers: handleSuccessfulCompletion() (line 1159), handleFailure() (line 1186), handleCancellation() (line 1192). Sets identity_token_revoked_at timestamp. Verify endpoint still returns 200 for revoked tokens with run_status reflecting terminal state — matches plan requirement.

evidence.title: Code review — Env injection via MergedEnvVars()
evidence.description: IdentityEnvVars() returns {"VROOLI_AGENT_IDENTITY_TOKEN": token} or nil. MergedEnvVars() merges custom → sandbox → identity vars (identity last, highest precedence). No per-runner changes needed — all runners receive merged env via ExecuteRequest.Environment. Matches plan's non-goal of not modifying per-runner buildEnv().

evidence.title: Code review — Startup failure on secret error
evidence.description: main.go line 331 calls identity.LoadOrCreateSecret(database.DataDir()). LoadOrCreateSecret returns error for unreadable files, wrong-size files, and unwritable directories. main.go propagates this as a startup failure. Matches plan's security-first approach.
